import hashlib, json, pathlib, sys
import gguf
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path.cwd() / 'tools'))
from build_depth_quant_controls import metadata
from depth_quant_screen import hash_file

base_path = pathlib.Path.home() / '.cache/breeze-models/breeze-tts-2-q4_k.gguf'
donor_path = pathlib.Path.home() / '.cache/breeze-models/depth-quant-controls/breeze-depth-ffn-q3_k-calibrated-attn-q4_k.gguf'
out_path = donor_path.with_name('breeze-current-ffn-q3-calibrated.gguf')
assert not out_path.exists()
assert hash_file(base_path) == '483418fbbb438f5f1c08dbe2b017e42db0f1d126765cd3f772d8622a30a4915c'
assert hash_file(donor_path) == 'c5836c86c2a14c6b224f378b99ae289817c5d98335f3281d4f4cff41abf0a55d'
base, donor = gguf.GGUFReader(base_path), gguf.GGUFReader(donor_path)
names = {f'dd.blk.{i}.ffn_{kind}.weight' for i in range(12) for kind in ('gate','up','down')}
by_name = {t.name:t for t in donor.tensors}
writer = gguf.GGUFWriter(out_path.with_suffix('.part'), 'breeze-tts-2')
for key, (types, value) in metadata(base).items():
    writer.add_key_value(key, value, types[0], types[-1] if len(types)>1 else None)
for tensor in base.tensors:
    source = by_name[tensor.name] if tensor.name in names else tensor
    assert np.array_equal(source.shape, tensor.shape)
    if tensor.name in names: assert source.tensor_type == gguf.GGMLQuantizationType.Q3_K
    writer.add_tensor(tensor.name, source.data, raw_dtype=source.tensor_type)
writer.write_header_to_file(); writer.write_kv_data_to_file(); writer.write_tensors_to_file(); writer.close()
candidate = gguf.GGUFReader(out_path.with_suffix('.part'))
assert metadata(base) == metadata(candidate)
assert [t.name for t in base.tensors] == [t.name for t in candidate.tensors]
records=[]
for before, after in zip(base.tensors, candidate.tensors):
    expected = by_name[before.name] if before.name in names else before
    assert np.array_equal(before.shape, after.shape)
    assert expected.tensor_type == after.tensor_type and np.array_equal(expected.data, after.data)
    records.append(dict(name=after.name, source='calibrated_ffn' if before.name in names else 'baseline', type=after.tensor_type.name, bytes=int(after.n_bytes), sha256=hashlib.sha256(after.data.tobytes()).hexdigest()))
assert sum(r['source']=='calibrated_ffn' for r in records)==36
out_path.with_suffix('.part').rename(out_path)
receipt=dict(base_sha256=hash_file(base_path), donor_sha256=hash_file(donor_path), output=str(out_path), output_sha256=hash_file(out_path), tensors=records, metadata_identical=True, other_tensors_byte_identical=True, script=pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text())
(pathlib.Path(__file__).parent/'model.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
print(receipt['output_sha256'],out_path)

import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,re,subprocess,sys,time
root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
prefix=['kubectl','-n','hermes-voice','exec','breezetts-dev','--']
text='The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. We are benchmarking the Breeze TTS two model on the Radeon 780 M graphics card, measuring the real time factor of the full generation pipeline from the text encoder through the backbone and depth decoder.'
text=os.environ.get('BREEZE_BENCH_TEXT',text)
label=sys.argv[1]; pack=sys.argv[2]; repeat=sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv)>3 else '3'
cmd=prefix+['env','-u','GGML_VK_TEST_PACKED_Q4_MMVQ','-u','GGML_VK_DISABLE_FUSION','-u','GGML_VK_FORCE_MMVQ','-u','GGML_VK_DISABLE_MMVQ','-u','GGML_VK_PERF_LOGGER','GGML_VK_ALLOW_GRAPHICS_QUEUE=1','BREEZE_PACK_WEIGHTS='+pack,'BREEZE_VOC_TRIM=1','BREEZE_VOC_CONVT_MATMUL=1','BREEZE_VOC_STATEFUL=0','BREEZE_DD_FUSED=0','/src/build/breeze-cli',('/tmp/breeze-current-ffn-q3-calibrated.gguf' if '-q3-' in label else '/models/breeze-tts-2-q4_k.gguf'),'--text',text,'--instruction','Speak clearly and naturally.','--seed','42','--repeat',repeat,'--timings','--output','/tmp/refresh-'+label+'.wav']
cmd.insert(cmd.index('/src/build/breeze-cli'),'BREEZE_V_CACHE_TRANSPOSED=0')
if len(sys.argv)>4: cmd += ['--voice',sys.argv[4],'--voices-dir','/tmp/voices']
p=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=300)
(root/(label+'.log')).write_text(p.stdout)
rows=[]
for part in p.stdout.split('generation wall')[1:]:
 wall=float(re.search(r'^\s+([\d.]+) ms',part)[1]); frames,duration=re.search(r'(\d+) frames, ([\d.]+) s audio',part).groups()
 first=float(re.search(r'time to first audio\s+([\d.]+)',part)[1]); stages={k:float(re.search(r'^\s*'+k+r'\s+([\d.]+) ms',part,re.M)[1]) for k in ['backbone decode','depth decode','vocoder']}
 rows.append({'wall_ms':wall,'frames':int(frames),'audio_s':float(duration),'wall_rtf':wall/1000/float(duration),'first_audio_ms':first,'stages_ms':stages})
paths=['/tmp/refresh-'+label+('' if n==1 else '.repeat-'+str(n))+'.wav' for n in range(1,int(repeat)+1)]
hashes=subprocess.run(prefix+['sha256sum']+paths,capture_output=True,text=True)
record={'label':label,'command':cmd,'returncode':p.returncode,'binary_md5':subprocess.check_output(prefix+['md5sum','/src/build/breeze-cli'],text=True).strip(),'source':os.environ.get('BREEZE_BENCH_SOURCE') or subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'runs':rows,'warmup':1,'wav_sha256':hashes.stdout,'log_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.stdout.encode()).hexdigest()}
(root/(label+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
if p.returncode or len(rows)!=int(repeat) or hashes.returncode:sys.exit(1)

import os, pathlib, subprocess, sys
root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
cases=[('report-q4-a',None,None),('report-q3-a',None,None),('report-q3-b',None,None),('report-q4-b',None,None)]
text='The laundry has finished, and the back door is locked. It might rain this afternoon, so please bring the cushions inside. Your next meeting starts at half past two.'
cases += [(f'home-{model}-a',text,None) for model in ('q4','q3')]
cases += [(f'voice-{model}-a',text,'test17s') for model in ('q4','q3')]
for label,text,voice in cases:
    env=os.environ.copy()
    if text: env['BREEZE_BENCH_TEXT']=text
    cmd=[sys.executable,str(root/'run.py'),label,'1','3']
    if voice: cmd.append(voice)
    subprocess.run(cmd,env=env,check=True)
